title: The draft copy can split a heavy shared unit into shared block parts, behind a chain trial
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A shared unit heavier than the average part gives up its heaviest shared blocks as units of their own, and the heaviest part gets lighter.
Each part's narrowed plan, notes and message hold only its own shared blocks.
Light shared blocks, one part, or a run without the setting are cut exactly as before.

tests: each part plans, notes and is told only its own shared blocks
light shared blocks, one part, or a run that does not ask for the split are cut exactly as before
